newsitem.title: USA: IPO PRICING - Sabre at $27, deal seen hot.
newsitem.headline: IPO PRICING - Sabre at $27, deal seen hot.

text.p: Sabre Group Holdings Inc's initial public offering of 20.2 million shares was priced at $27 a share for the company's initial public offering, lead underwriter Goldman Sachs said on Friday.
Sabre is due to begin trading today and the analysts have said they expect the offering to skyrocket.
The AMR Corp unit provides computer travel reservations and information and is based in Fort Worth, Texas.
Goldman Sachs said of the total number of shares, 16.16 million were sold in the United States and 4.04 million were sold overseas.
